name: Poha Cutlet
steps: Rinse poha briefly in a sieve, drain and rest for 10 minutes until soft; mash the boiled potatoes.
Combine poha, potato, grated carrot, finely chopped onion, ginger, chilli, coriander, rice flour and salt.
Knead lightly until the mixture holds together; shape into 8 flat cutlets without cracks.
Heat oil in a wide pan; cook cutlets on medium heat for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and hot throughout.
tips: Let washed poha drain fully; excess water makes the cutlets fragile.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
